Commentary.Commentary: Things seemed like they would go out of control, but towards the fag end, Hong Kong mounted a late assault. From 242/3 in the 42nd over, India finished the innings on 285/7. Those middle order woes showing themselves once again. Kinchit Shah was the pick of the lot as he scalped a 3-fer, with the two Khans and Ehsan Nawaz doing their part as well. The wicket is on the slower side and it will be a challenge for Hong Kong, especially given the arsenal in India's bowling ranks. Should be a good chase. Join us shortly for the action.

India might be happy with what they have on the board, all said and done, but a superb comeback from Hong Kong after a rather loose start. India were put into bat and the two openers provided a good start. Sharma was dismissed though, but post that, Dhawan and Rayudu took control of things. A century stand between them brought things in their favour, with Rayudu getting out after scoring a fifty. Shikhar, however, continued with Karthik and added 79, scoring a good ton himself.
A single to end things. Kedar Jadhav sweeps it through square leg and gets a single. INDIA FINISH ON 285/7!
Driven through mid on by the batsman. The batsmen have picked up a couple of runs.
Kuldeep Yadav is the next man in.

OUT! Thakur perishes in the quest for some quick runs in the end. Khan, again rolling his fingers over the ball, beats Thakur by pace. He is early into his shot trying to go over the straight boundary. The ball lobs to the fielder at long off who comes in a couple of steps and takes it easily. 7th one down for India.
A good length off cutter around off. Kedar trying to hit too hard may be, mistimes it completely to get just a single into the leg side.

Cutter, a bit shorter around off. Jadhav goes for the pull but does not get the desired connection. The ball rolls near the ring towards the mid-wicket region and allows the pair to run back for the second.

That is typical Kedar Jadhav. Khan again rolls his fingers over this one and keeps it fuller on the stumps. Kedar looking to club it into the leg side ends up sweeping it to the deep square leg region to take a brace.
The batsman goes after this one but misses the line completely. 6 more balls to go.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads.
Shardul Thakur comes in next.

OUT! Kinchit picks up his third and he is a major reason why Hong Kong have restricted India in these death overs. Keeps it a bit short, angling across, and very slow. Bhuvi looks to pull but gets it off the bottom of his bat. The ball lobs into the mid-wicket region where the Hong Kong skipper, Anshuman Rath, runs across and takes a nice catch to end Bhuvi's short innings.
Jadhav drives this full ball to mid on for a single.
A bit faster and fuller around off, Jadhav looking to heave it away into the leg side misses the ball.
Kumar pulls this shortish delivery into the square leg region to change strike on the very first ball of the penultimate over.
Beaten again. Slower outside off, a bit short of a good length. Jadhav tries to smash this out of Dubai but misses it because of some intelligent change of pace by Khan. Good ball to end the over.
Kumar tries to swing across the line as the ball bounces a bit more than he expects and takes the top edge but lands safe and they cross for a single.
Kumar drives superbly to the covers but straight to the fielder.

Beaten! The slower ball executed well. Bhuvi dances down the track before Aizaz has even leapt. He sees the batsman and bowls an off cutter a bit shorter in length and outside off. Bhuvi tries to heave it into the leg side, wildly, but misses the ball completely. Smart change of pace by Khan.
Shorter in length this and a bit slower in pace as well. Kedar waits and pulls it to deep square leg for just a single.
Keeps it marginally short of a good length around off and angling into the batsman. Looks like Kumar is cramped for room as he taps the ball into the mid-wicket region to change strike.
Wide! Wayward to start the over as he strays this way down the leg side. Tried to go for the variation on the very first ball and hence missed his line completely.
Aizaz Khan is back on.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot.
Full and flicked to square leg.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball.
Kedar drives it to mid off.
Cheeky from the man from Pune. Kedar waits till the very last moment and then opens the face for the ball to kiss the face. Placed wide of short third man for a double.
Kinchit continues with a full length ball outside off, Kumar opens the bat face and glides this towards point for a single.

SIX! Hit as clean as a whistle! What a hit. Full and in the slot, Jadhav clears his front leg and gets under the ball. Lifts it cleanly over long on as the ball crashes into the sightscreen. Phenomenal hit.
Outside off, run to short third man.
Flicked neatly through the mid-wicket region for two more.
Hits the deck hard and bangs it in short, outside off, Kedar has nothing to do with it. Wide called.
Back of a length angling in on middle and leg, pulled behind square leg using the angle in to him. A couple of runs result.
Full again, angling in on middle and leg, this time Kumar manages to play it towards mid on for a single.
Comes charging in and spears it in the blockhole on middle and leg, Kumar digs it out towards mid-wicket.
A shorter delivery just outside off is pushed into the point region for a single.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman. kumar retains strike.

Dropped again. But this was as difficult as the one which went down a few overs ago. These either stick or don't. Jadhav charges down the track, converts the full length ball into a full toss and bunts it straight down the ground. Shah puts his left hand up in hope of the ball sticking but it does not. The ball rolls down towards the mid off region and they take a single.
Kumar flicks it away with a wristy shot towards square leg to pick up another run.

Good bowling this as he changes his pace cleverly. Bowls it much slower and full on off. Bhuvi, looking to turn it into the on side, is a bit too early into the shot and hence gets a leading edge. No run there.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
A bit slower and outside off, Kedar waits and taps it to point at the last moment.
Jadhav has defended this off the front foot.
A bit shorter in length and is punched into the covers to take a single.
A bit wide of the off stump. Kumar, new to the crease, shoulders arms.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Kedar has flicked the ball off his pads to pick up a single.
Nawaz comes back into the attack.
Pulls this short ball hard into the deep square leg region but gets just a single.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman. One run added to the total. Hong Kong won't mind singles at this stage.
Jadhav rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball. One run added to the total.
Bhuvneshwar Kumar is the next batsman in.

OUT! Holes out in the deep, He had to go for it. Dinesh goes down looking to slog sweep this one over the mid-wicket fence but gets a top edge and the ball flies up in the air towards the deep square leg region, Babar Hayat sprints a long way to his right, dives and holds on to a very well judged catch to send Karthik packing.
Tossed up on middle, turned into the mid-wicket region to take a single.
Kinchit starts this over with a quicker one darted just outside off. Left alone by Kedar. Settling himself in may be.

FOUR! Spinning in, on a fuller length, Karthik kneels forward and across and sweeps it fine down the leg side for a boundary. Khan has been expensive, but he's finished the spell well with an important wicket. Ends with returns of 10-0-65-2.
Jadhav is off the mark. Drives it through mid off for a single.
Kedar Jadhav to bat next.

OUT! And Dhoni is gone! Arguably the best finisher in the business walks back without inflicting any sort of damage. Straighter one outside off, Dhoni gets deceived as he comes forward to play for the turn. Gets a faint edge and the keeper takes it sharply. Before the umpire even raises his finger, Dhoni starts walking. Delight on Khan's face. Understandably so too. India lose two wickets in quick succession.
Hangs back and blocks it with the full face of the bat.
Another inner edge, but this time it goes down the leg side. A single is taken.
Some sharp spin in from outside off, Karthik wears it on the pads, but not before getting an inside edge.
Quicker and flatter outside off, cut again, square on the off side, but straight to the fielder. A successful over from the offie comes to a close.
Short and flat outside off, cut square through the off side for a run.
MS Dhoni walks into the middle next.

OUT! And his rollercoaster knock finally comes to an end. He would have liked to stay till the end, but he'll still feel content with how he's played. Good bowling this from Kinchit Shah though. Deserves full credit for the breakthrough. Keeps coming from around the wicket and bowls it slower through the air, Dhawan gets low to bang it over the leg side but gets beaten in the flight and a top edge is induced. Tanwir Afzal at backward point settles himself under it and takes a good catch.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman. One run added to the total.

Technically a dropped chance, but no way he would have been able to take it. Nobody would have. Was hit too hard. Dhawan comes down the track and hammers this straight back to the bowler. Shah gets both hands to it, but can't hold on. It rolls behind and a single is taken. Kinchit saved a certain boundary there. For sure.
Full and outside off, Karthik reaches out to it and taps it square on the off side. A run is collected.
Powerplay 3 signalled. A maximum of 5 fielders will be allowed outside the ring till the end of the innings.
Full and attacking the stumps, swept square through the leg side. One run to end the over.
Aerially plays this one towards long on and gets to the other end.

SIX! That's high in the air and out of here! Tossed up with a lot of air in line of the stumps, Shikhar Dhawan stands his ground and lifts it high over mid-wicket. Into the night sky and that's sent deep into the stands for a maximum.
Worked away with the spin towards mid-wicket and a single is taken.
FOUR! Well played, DK. The line is a bit too straight, full in length, so Karthik is down as he sweeps it behind square leg for a boundary.
Spinning in sharply on middle and leg, catches Karthik on the pads as he tries to play at it.
Good stop by the fielder. Dhawan connects the sweep well and plays it towards backward square leg. The man there dives to his left and stops it.
Driven towards the mid off region. They pick up a single.
Flighted delivery around off, Dhawan plays the reverse paddle and plays it to short third man. A quick single is taken.
Gives Shikhar the strike by nudging this off his pads to square leg and taking one.
Fired full and wide outside off, Dhawan gets low and drags the sweep off the inner half through mid-wicket for a run.
SIX! Cutting loose now. Has no second thoughts about going after this one. Gives the charge to the floated ball and smokes it over wide long on for half a dozen.

Not out! As expected. Landed well outside off, it comes in with the drift and Dhawan tries to get innovative. Attempts to bring out the reverse sweep but is caught on the thigh pad. Loud appeal goes up but the umpire doesn't pay attention to it. A leg bye is taken and in this time, Anshuman Rath decides to review it. Replays show the impact is clearly outside off. Hong Kong lose the review.
Review time. Hong Kong want to challenge the decision for an lbw against Shikhar Dhawan. Doesn't look out at all. Impact is well outside off.
Driven down the ground, through to long off and a single is taken.
Spinning in on middle and leg, this time Karthik wants to dispatch the ball with the big slog sweep but wears it on the pads instead.
Driven easily through the covers for a single.

SIX! Missed the last time, gets what he wants this time. Similar ball, Dhawan gets low and nails the slog sweep to perfection. Way over the mid-wicket boundary and that's a maximum. Brings up the 50-partnership with that.
Looking for the big one. Khan bowls it slower outside off, Dhawan wants to clear the mid-wicket fence but can't as the ball goes under his bat.
Full on the stumps, flicked neatly through the vacant spaces in the mid-wicket region for a brace.
DK has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Short and flat outside the line of off stump, punched to long off. One run collected.

FOUR! The lbw shout is denied, the umpire signals runs. Dhawan did play that late, dangerous and well-executed at the same time. Coming in on middle, Shikhar kneels forward and across before sweeping it past short fine leg for a boundary.
Karthik picks it off his pads and works it away into the leg side for a single.
Comfortably milks this to the long on fielder and crosses over.

14th ODI century for Shikhar Dhawan! A terrific effort from the opener. Hasn't put a single foot wrong in the entire innings. Chanceless. He just cracks this square on the off side and takes a single. He will look to accelerate from this point on. He's got what he wanted.
Driven down the ground through mid on for a single this time.
FOUR! Nice flow of the bat from Dinesh Karthik. Takes a nice, big stride to this full delivery outside off and crashes it right off the middle through the covers for a boundary.
Happy to just take the single. Dhawan moves to 99 by wristing this full delivery to long on.
That ball has taken the inside edge onto the pads. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Coming in on middle and leg, worked away on the leg side for a single.
Ehsan Khan to bowl once more.
The batsman has driven it through mid on. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Dinesh milks this to long off and takes one too.
Dhawan comfortably punches this to long on and gets to the other end.
Short ball in line of the stumps, pulled along the carpet to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Fuller and faster outside off, driven square to point.
A bit of a mishit from DK. Can't middle it as well as he'd have liked. Tries to club this length ball on off over mid off, but can only lob it as far as the fielder there.
No ball! Nawaz oversteps as he pitches this full on off, Karthik drives it to extra cover. Free Hit coming up on the next delivery...
Driven through the covers by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
FOUR! One bounce and across the rope. Nawaz angles in a bumper on middle and leg, Dhawan picks up the length early and moves inside the line before pulling it aerially towards fine leg. Super shot.
Fires this full and on the sixth stump line, drilled hard but right at the cover fielder.
Goes down the ground again, this time towards mid off. Can't beat the fielder though.
Nawaz starts off from around the wicket and angles in a length delivery around off, Dhawan stays deep inside the crease and plays it back down the track.
Sliding in on middle and leg, Dhawan uses the angle well to clip it through square leg for a run.
Knocked to long off with absolute ease and DK gets off strike.
Pushes this off the front foot straight to the man at cover.
Karthik has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Darted across again, on a shorter length, DK from the back foot cuts it late to backward point.
Comes from around the wicket and fires this across Dinesh Karthik. The batsman goes back and pushes it on the off side.
Kinchit Shah into the attack now. He will try with his off spin to make something happen.
FOUR! Good end to the over for India. Length ball going across, Dhawan is right on top of this as he comes half-forward and crunches it through cover-point for a boundary.
Back of a length delivery just outside off, Dinesh is on his toes as he rises on top of the ball and punches it through the gap on the off side for a single.
Moves inside the line to this length delivery, brings his wrists into play and turns it square on the leg side for a run.
The batsman works it down the leg side.
FOUR! Another short ball but this time Dhawan is prepared for it. Camps back, waits for it and pounces on it with a powerful pull. Beats the fine leg fielder and finds the fence.
Brings out the short ball and takes Dhawan by surprise, the batsman sways away from the line, albeit a little late.
Drinks break.
Stays behind the line and defends. Gets an inside edge onto the pads and that's the end of the over. That brings an end to Nadeem's spell. He finishes with figures of 10-0-39-0.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball down to long on. One run to the total.
Uses the depth of the crease to go back and keep it out on the off side.
Nicely done. Karthik comfortably drives it through to sweeper cover and rotates strike.
Turns it away with the spin, in front of square leg, and gets to the other end.
Turning in on middle, on a shorter length, Shikhar is on the back foot as he plays it in front of mid-wicket.
Fullish in length just outside off, blocked firmly by Karthik off the front foot to covers.
On the shorter side of the length, outside off, arms are shouldered to this one.
Short ball into the body, pulled down to fine leg for a single.
Off the mark without wasting any time. Karthik opens the face and runs this length ball down to third man for a run.
Dinesh Karthik is the next batsman in.

OUT! GONE! The bowling change does the trick for Hong Kong. Ehsan Khan strikes. Good move to have the keeper right up to the stumps. Short ball which rises off the deck surprisingly, Rayudu attempts to play the upper cut but can only manage a feather behind. Scott McKechnie takes a sharp catch and celebrates. The umpire just wants to check for the front foot no ball and replays show all is fine. Rayudu departs after scoring a well-crafted fifty. Timely wicket for Hong Kong. Partnership of 116 comes to an end.
Length ball outside off, Rayudu goes for the cut but mistimes it on the off side.
Ehsan Nawaz returns to the attack.
Not much spin on this occasion, turned away towards mid-wicket for nothing.
Pushed away tamely into the off side for a single.

SIX! Makes sweet connection on that! It's tossed right up there, in Rayudu's slot, the right-hander gets low on one knee and brings out the big sweep. Clears the mid-wicket boundary with ease as he sends it flying into the stands.
Driven towards the mid off region. They pick up a single.
Backs away to this arm ball sliding in on off, Rayudu punches it to sweeper cover for a single.
Quicker delivery outside off, on a shorter length, a mistimed cut finds its way to the point fielder.
Hangs back inside the crease and offers a defensive blade in response.
Pushed into the vacant spaces in the cover region for a single.

FOUR! 7th ODI fifty for Ambati Rayudu! It's come in a streaky manner, but he won't mind. Room on offer outside off, a length delivery, Rayudu throws his bat at it and gets a fat edge through the vacant slip cordon to the third man boundary. A solid knock from him so far.
A bit of a brash shot from Rayudu. Shortish ball around off, it's slapped straight back to the bowler with an angled bat.
Short of a good length outside off, the bat face is opened before steering it to the diving backward point fielder.
Connects well but there's a fielder in the deep. Dhawan gets on top of the short ball and pulls it through to deep mid-wicket for a single.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Full and attacking the stumps, nudged down the ground through mid on. Shikhar rotates the strike.
Ambati Rayudu goes with the spin and drives it through covers for a single. With this, the 100-run stand is also up.
Sliding across the southpaw, Dhawan taps it down on the off side off the outer half. Calls for the run swiftly and his partner responds too. Nicely done.
Stays on the back foot this time, around off, a solid punch is offered to long off for one run.
Loopy delivery full in length, outside off, the right-hander strides ahead and pushes it to mid off.
Rayudu moves across his sticks and with a little swivel, he pulls this along the ground through square leg. A run to end the over.
Full on middle and leg, easy enough for Shikhar to flick this through square leg for a single.
Keeps it tight. Length delivery on the stumps, kept out from within the crease.
Just behind a length, outside off, punched firmly off the back foot through the covers. One to the scoreboard.
FOUR! Short of a length delivery into the body, Rayudu picks up the length early and rocks back. Swivels and pulls it aerially through backward square leg for a boundary. No stopping that.
Length delivery rising off the deck, Ambati stands firm and blocks it with a straight blade.
Dhawan comes ahead and defends the fuller ball on the off side.
Short, flat and outside off, cut past the backward point fielder. Two easy runs for the batsmen.
Milks this full ball down to long off and gets to the other end.
Big shout for a leg before, but not given. Clearly going down leg. Arm ball on leg, sliding further down, Rayudu is down to sweep but misses and is rapped on the front pad. Good call from the umpire.
Spinning away from around off, a touch of extra bounce, Rayudu plays it off the outer half to short third man.
Spinning in on middle and leg, Shikhar plays this with the spin as he works it through mid-wicket comfortably. One run collected.
Dhawan drives this to long off to pick up one more single and move onto 69.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.

Good shot but Rayudu will not be ecstatic with the final result. He will feel that he could have hit it to the boundary 9 out of 10 times. Lands this short and wide, in the perfect zone to be cut hard. Ambati does exactly that, times it well as well but straight to the man at sweeper cover. A run taken.
Khan keeps it in the corridor around off, Rayudu defends off the front foot.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Khan starts with a shortish delivery angling into Shikhar's body, Shikhar though pulls it to the deep square leg region for a single.
Aizaz Khan is brought back into the attack.
Dhawan comes forward and turns this one into the mid-wicket region to take a single and retain strike.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Turns this ball attacking the stumps into the square leg region, but the fielder is swift enough to stop the batsmen from crossing over.
Drives well but straight to covers.
Driven towards the mid-off region. One run added to the total.
Fuller and straighter ball is flicked into the mid-wicket region and the pair pick up a single.
This is the exact definition of milking the bowling. A boundary or two each over and singles off almost each ball. Dhawan drives this through the cover region to pick up a single.
Rayudu drives this tossed up ball through mid on to exchange strike one more time.
Shikhar flicks it away with a wristy shot to pick up a single.

FOUR! Dominating shot! Full of authority. Dhawan stands tall in his crease, waits for the good length ball to arrive near him and swings through the line to get the ball up and over mid off. Calculated risk this from Shikhar which gives him a boundary.
Keeps it slower but a bit shorter outside off, Dhawan cuts it through the cover-point region for a double.
Afzal starts with a slower one around off, Rayudu steers this towards point by opening the bat face and runs through for a single.
Tanwir Afzal is back on.
A fuller length delivery is driven to long on to pick up another single.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
FOUR! Rayudu on the move now as he has nonchalantly lofted this over the man stationed at extra cover. The timing on it is exquisite as the ball goes past the fence in a jiffy.
Played to the mid-wicket region by the batsman.
Continues with the tight line and length. Rayudu skips down the track looking to reach the pitch of the delivery but cannot and tries to block it out. The ball takes the inner edge onto his pads.
Worked away into the leg side with a closed face and a single results.

SIX! Another short delivery and it's been punished. Around off, Rayudu goes back and with all his might, heaves it over the cow corner. It sails into the stands for a biggie. 15 off this over, big one for the Men in Blue.
Knocked down the ground towards long on. One more to the total.
FOUR! Authoritative! Shikhar Dhawan is in his elements. Short and on the stumps, the southpaw quickly shifts back and muscles the pull through mid-wicket, beating the man in the deep with ease.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman. One run added to the total.
A fraction straight in line, nicely tossed up, flicked through mid-wicket for a single.

Fifty for Shikhar Dhawan! His 26th in this format. A good knock from Gabbar here, been flawless since he started. Just leans ahead and drives it through the covers for a couple of runs. He looks primed for a big one. Also, the 50-run stand is up.
Nizakat Khan is introduced into the bowling attack.
Short and flat, pulled hard through mid-wicket. The man from wide long on does well to cover good ground to his right and keeps the batsmen to just two.
Nicely done. Nadeem bowls this quite slow through the air, deceives Rayudu in the flight who dances down. The batsman can only block it to covers.
Darts it on the stumps, full in length, Dhawan works it gently on the leg side and crosses over.
A good extension of the arms as Rayudu drives it nicely through the covers for one.
Bowls this a bit fuller, slower through the air on this occasion, Rayudu meets it with the full face of the bat.
Shorter and a bit quicker through the air around off, blocked out off the back foot.
A fuller length ball in line with the stumps is flicked into the mid-wicket region for a single to end a good over from Ehsan Khan.
Tossed up around off, Dhawan waits for it to arrive, pushes it softly into the gap at covers and steals a quick single.
A bit shorter of a full length on middle is driven to long off and they cross for a single. Good tight over so far, just three runs off four balls.
Tossed up on off, defended  off the back foot.
Keeps it full around off, Shikhar comes forward and pushes it into the gap in the cover region to take a quick single.

Tossed up on off, driven to long on for an easy single. It is an important innings for Rayudu as he is kind of making a comeback into the Indian side and he knows that he will not get many chances like this, so cashing in is essential.
Slightly shorter in length on off, Dhawan goes back and punches it to the man at covers. A good over after the drinks break for Hong Kong, just 1 from it.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Stump-to-stump line, not giving the batsman a lot of room to work with. Dhawan prods forward and blocks it out.
With the turn, Dhawan works it to mid-wicket.
Fires it on the stumps, Rayudu goes down on one knee and sweeps it through square leg to change strike.
Flatter delivery on off, straightens a touch. Rayudu lunges and defends it.

Drinks break. A decent start by Hong Kong as they have managed to keep India below the six-run-per-over mark in addition to the big wicket of The Hitman. India will want Dhawan to make this start count and get a big one today, he needs it as well. Rayudu will look to give adequate support and build a big partnership.
Dhawan shows respect as he gets back to this shorter length ball around off and blocks it out solidly to enter the first drinks break unbeaten.
Rayudu leans across and flicks this flighted delivery into the square leg region for a single.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket.
Tossed up on middle stump line, flicked to mid-wicket to pick up a single.
FOUR! The umpteenth time Dhawan has cut it for a boundary through point. Poor from Khan, seems as if it slipped from his hand. It lands very short and wide of off, Dhawan will cut these in his sleep.
Rayudu is milking the bowling as he is changing strike nicely and giving as much strike to the well set opener as possible. He drives it through mid on for a run.
A flighted delivery and full in length around off is driven elegantly through mid off for a single to finish the over.
Dhawan comes forward on this fuller length ball and blocks it out solidly. Very good this from Ahmed as he is not giving anything to the Indian batsmen here.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
A tossed up fuller length ball around off is driven nicely through mid off for a single to be added.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Fourth consecutive similar shot and the result, again, is a single added to the total.
Punched again into the cover-point region and another single results.
Similar ball to the right-hander this time, Ambati punches it into the covers for a single.
Similar ball but Shikhar's punch finds the gap this time and allows the batsmen to cross over for a single.
Slower and fractionally shorter, punched off the back foot to the covers.
Defended off the front foot by Shikhar presenting the full face of the bat.
Rayudu cuts this shorter and wider delivery with good timing, but cannot find the gap, which is as important.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
A fuller and straighter ball in line with the stumps is flicked through mid-wicket for a brace.
A bit slower and with an angle into the right-hander, who waits for the ball to arrive and blocks it out.
Tossed up around off again, Ambati comes forward and defends.
Rayudu shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Nadeem Ahmed is the new bowler into the attack.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Driven crisply to covers to pick up an easy single.
Gabbar again rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball and steals a single.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
A straighter ball attacking the stumps is worked down the leg side for a single.
Shikhar rocks onto the back foot and punches this into the cover region for a single.
A shortish length ball around off, is punched into the gap in covers to pick up a single and the southpaw retains strike.

FOUR! That's pulled with disdain. A short ball again on Shikhar's body. The inexperience of the Hong Kong bowlers is on display here. Shikhar swivels and unleashes a hard pull shot for the ball to race across the outfield like a tracer bullet.
Rayudu rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball into the cover region for a single.
Rayudu takes the risk and gets two for it. Walks down the track and lofts this one over the cover region. The timing is not sensational as the fielder chases it down and keeps it to a brace.
A shortish ball around off is pushed into the cover region.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot to end the a good over for India. India are 56/1 at the end of Powerplay 1.
A bit wide of off, left alone.
Played to the point region by the batsman.

FOUR! The bowler repeats the mistake and pays the price again. You cannot err against such world class batsmen. Short and wide of off again, bread and butter for Dhawan as he smashes this cut through point to bring up yet another boundary. Shikhar moves to 30.
FOUR! Dhawan will not let these freebies go by. A shortish ball just outside off is fiercely cut through the covers. The ball races away to the fence and Dhawan has another boundary to his name.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot.
Played to the point region by the batsman. Good ball to end the over by Khan.
And Ambati is off the mark as he turns this ball angling into the stumps, into the mid-wicket region. The timing is better than we expected and the batsmen come back for a brace.
Dhawan has driven this full ball around off through mid off. The batsmen have run through for a single
A bit short, angling into Dhawan. He misses the flick and gets rapped on the pads.
Fuller in length is driven to mid on.
Outside off, played to point.
Keeps it wide of off and Rayudu decides to let it go.
Fuller and straighter delivery is turned into the mid-wicket region.
Ambati Rayudu is the next batsman in.

OUT! Rohit Sharma is gone! Spin does the trick for Hong Kong and that's a big wicket! Khan floats it up on middle and off, Rohit gives the charge and swings to go big over the leg side. There's a hint of drift away and that becomes his undoing. The ball takes the leading edge and balloons towards mid off. Nizakat Khan is the man positioned there, he takes a couple of steps back and gobbles it up well. India's Hitman departs early.
Dhawan prods forward and taps it into the mid-wicket region to change strike.
Keeps this on a tighter line around middle and off, coming in with the angle from around the wicket, it's worked through mid-wicket for a single.
Tossed up around off, driven crisply to the fielder at covers.
Ehsan Khan comes into the attack.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Back of a length outside off, kept out off the back foot.
Leans ahead to this full delivery and drives it straight to the man at mid off.
Behind a good length, just sits up for Dhawan who shifts his weight onto the back foot and pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Some width on offer outside off, on a length once more, it's dabbed square to point for an easy one.
Just ahead of a length, on middle and off with some shape away, Rohit stays perfectly behind the line and keeps it out.
First change made quite early. Aizaz Khan brought on to bowl.

FOUR! A bit agricultural this from Dhawan as he tries to heave at this short of a length ball on middle, angling away from him from over the wicket. Dhawan, from within his crease, pulls and gets a good connection. The ball flies over the square leg region for the second boundary of this expensive over.

FOUR! A classic cover drive, can it get any beautiful than this? Dhawan looking in good touch here as he is middling almost everything today. A very full ball wide of off, Shikhar goes down on one knee and stylishly drives this through covers for a smashing boundary.
A short of a length ball is tapped towards point.
Nawaz pulls his length back a bit and keeps it around off. Dhawan defends off the back foot.
Similar delivery and a similar shot as Dhawan creams this drive straight to the fielder at covers.
A full length ball on off is driven superbly through the covers.
FOUR! This time it's the mid on fielder again who looks skywards to see the ball flying over his head and into the fence after a couple of bonces. Two in two and Sharma is on his way.

FOUR! This is like net practice for Rohit. With the speed around 110-115 kph, Rohit just stands in his crease and swings through the line. The surface is good enough as the ball is lofted well over mid on and it races across the fence.
Fuller length around off is driven to mid off for a single.

Smart bowling this from Afzal. He knows that the southpaw likes the ball coming onto the bat nicely, hence he is rolling his fingers over the ball. The batsmen have no pace to work with and this is frustrating the Indian opening pair. It's played to point.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
FOUR! Dhawan will hit these 10 out of 10 times. Afzal drifts onto Shikhar's pads. The batsman leans across and flicks it nonchalantly through mid-wicket for a cracking boundary.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

FOUR! That shot is a result of the previous four dots. Rohit premeditates as he wants to score quick runs. A bit shorter this one around off, he swings across the line and swats at it dragging the ball through the square leg region as it crosses the boundary.
Marginally short of a good length around off, Rohit drives it to mid on.
A bit short and wide is cut hard but straight to point.
A fuller ball on off, Rohit, from within his crease, drives straight to the fielder at covers.
Nawaz starts a new over by landing it a bit shorter than a good length around off. Rohit gets behind the line of the ball and keeps it out.
A straight ball angling into the stumps is flicked to square leg. No run on offer.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
On a length attacking the stumps, Shikhar turns it towards mid-wicket.
Similar ball around middle and leg, cramping Dhawan for room who blocks it out.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket.

FOUR! A classic Dhawan shot as he rocks back and across seeing the width on that one and unleashes a fierce cut through the cover-point region. The timing and placement are immaculate. A boundary results.
A good length ball angling into the pads is flicked to square leg for a single to end the over.
Sharma rocks back quickly seeing the length a bit short and cuts it through the point region. The fielder chases it down and keeps it down to a brace.
A shortish ball around off is steered softly to the point region to get a single.
Very full ball on off is driven to mid off.
Lands this one on a length on middle, angling into the batsman. Rohit looks to flick but misses to get rapped on the pads and the ball rolls towards square leg and the batsmen steal a leg bye.
Starts with a back of a length delivery around off, Sharma gets behind it and keeps it out safely.
Ehsan Nawaz to bowl from the other end with the second new ball.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Length ball around off is tapped into the point region and the batsmen take a run.
FOUR! Delightful! Rohit at his elegant best here. A full one outside off is creamed through the cover region and the ball races across the ropes and India get their first boundary.
Very full on off, driven to mid off where the fielder misfields allowing Shikhar to get off the mark.
Nice adjustment by the bowler as he hits the corridor around off to the left-hander as well. Dhawan keeps it out onto the off side.

Rohit Sharma and India are off the mark on the very first delivery. A good length ball around off is gently tapped into the cover-point region and the batting pair takes a single to open its team's account.

The national anthems are done and dusted with now. We are ready to get underway as the umpires make their way to the middle along with the Hong Kong players. The Indian opening pair of their skipper, Rohit Sharma and Shikhar Dhawan, stride out with the former taking strike. Tanwir Afzal to start the proceedings for Hong Kong.

India captain, Rohit Sharma says that getting used to the conditions as soon as possible is the most important thing for them and informs that his side is ready to go out and give their best. Also states that Asia cup is the continent's biggest tournament with a long history behind it. Reckons that it's a very competitive tournament and believes that they have to give their best all the time in order to succeed on a consistent basis. Informs that many of his players have come here for the first time and it is their first Asia Cup as well. Admits that their batting, especially the middle order, is something that excites him. Also informs that Khaleel Ahmed will make his debut. Ends by saying that even though, historically, their batting has always been strong and the bowling usually was the one which underperformed for them, but the last 2-3 years have seen the Indian bowlers doing a fantastic job and winning matches for their team.

Hong Kong skipper, Anshuman Rath says they are keen to showcase their skills. Adds further that some hard lessons were learnt in the last game and feels that it is inexcusable how their batting collapsed. Expects a better show from his team today as they try and restrict India as much as possible. States that today his players will look to give their best performance with a smile on their faces, enjoying the game. Ends by saying that there is some grass covering on the surface and expects the pitch to remain good for batting throughout the day.
TOSS - Hong Kong won the toss and elected to bowl.

Hola, everyone! Welcome to our coverage of the 4th match of the tournament between the mighty Indians and the minnows Hong Kong in Dubai. India will be looking to put in a dominant performance in all three departments of the game and come up with a clinical show. Hong Kong, on the other hand, will be keen to make full use of this opportunity, do the basics right and put up a competitive show against the Men in Blue. Will we see another one-sided thrashing of a weaker team by the obvious stronger one? Or can this funny game throw up another surprise, as it has done time and again in the past?
